subject: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Team —

Thanks for the strong work getting the Quarter Anchor playbook to this point. Attached is v1.3 of the playbook plus a one-sheet OKR mapping showing proposed owners and committed targets. This is the consolidated version after the product/engineering and GTM passes.

As a quick checklist before exec sign-off I need: 
- Kimberly: confirmation on the resource commitments and any open hiring asks (highlighted in the playbook).
- Grace: any gating risks from customer success or product (esp. around model rollout windows).
- Logan: a single-line green/red on the measurement plan and dashboard readiness.

External ask: Sasha — we included the partner integration milestones you outlined; can you confirm the integration milestones on page 8 are achievable on your side? If not, flag the earliest blocker.

Please reply with explicit sign-off (or a short edit) by EOD PT today. If we get all thumbs up I will schedule the QBR dry run for Tuesday 12/22 at 10am PT and send the invite.

Attachments: Q1_anchor_playbook_v1.3.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB), OKR_mapping_owners.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

—
Ben Carter
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Ben —

Thanks. Quick responses inline: 
- Headcount: Hiring asks on pages 10–11 are confirmed but we can only commit to 3/5 requisitions for Q1; two are contingent on budget approvals in the Jan planning window. I updated the hires tab in OKR_mapping_owners.xlsx (column "commitment_level").
- Budget: We have provisional allocation for tooling and cloud credits; I'll follow up with finance to convert to firm allocations before the QBR dry run.

I have one minor edit suggestion: shift the DB migration milestone (pg->kv) from week 6 to week 8 to avoid overlapping with a security patch window. Marked in the playbook PDF. Otherwise I can sign off to proceed.

kimberly_park
Director, Finance & Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Ben —

Reviewing from CS/product perspective: 
- Risks: two customer-facing risk items on page 6 (model latency under peak load; feature flag rollback plan) need a clearer rollback owner. Suggest assigning to "Platform Reliability" (we should list a specific on-call name) — added as a comment in the PDF.
- Dependencies: Sasha — the partner integration milestone looks OK but we need the webhook schema + auth details by 12/28 to keep our dev schedule intact. Can you confirm?

I can sign off on the objectives and measures provided the DB migration shift Kimberly proposed is accepted and we add a single rollback owner for the release window.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer & Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Ben / team —

Thanks for the close coordination. Confirming the integration milestones — we can commit to the dates in the playbook assuming we get the webhook schema / auth spec by 12/28. Contracts Team (cc'd) will push the SOW addendum back to you by Monday EOD for signature.

We flagged one small ask in the playbook comments: can the partner milestone include a short "acceptance test" checklist (3 bullets) so our QA can align? We can draft that and send it to Grace.

Sasha
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Integrations
Acme Analytics
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Quick check — measurement plan and dashboards: green. Dashboard templates for the three leading indicators are live in Looker (link in drive). I recommend we run one mock pipeline run during the QBR dry run to validate the telemetry.

LGTM — please accept the DB migration shift and add the rollback owner.

—Logan
Director, Analytics & Reporting
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter anchor playbook: final review and sign-off

Thank you all — consolidated decisions: 
- Kimberly: commit to 3/5 hires now; two hires contingent on Jan budget conversion.
- Migration: shift pg->kv migration to week 8 (accepted).
- Rollback: assign Platform Reliability on-call as rollback owner (I will add the specific name and on-call rotation to the playbook before the dry run).
- Measurement: Logan to run mock pipeline during dry run.
- Sasha/Acme: partner confirms milestones conditional on webhook spec by 12/28; Contracts will send SOW addendum Monday.

We have implicit sign-off from all internal owners in this thread. I will update the playbook with Kimberly's hire commitment column, add the rollback owner, and circulate a final v1.4 before the dry run.

Dry run invite: 2026-12-22 10:00–11:30 PT (calendar invite to follow). Please bring one slide per function with two top risks and mitigations.

Ben
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
